summary.what_it_does: The page is a biography and profile for Hidekazu Konishi, who describes himself as an AI Solutions Architect working across AWS, Azure, GCP and on-premises environments. It states his areas of expertise: AI-augmented software development, AI agent engineering, cloud architecture, and research in DevOps, MLOps, AIOps and generative AI. It says he publishes technical blogs and books and offers consulting. It also lists awards, including Japan AWS Top Engineer and Japan All AWS Certifications Engineer for 2020 to 2026. The listing text notes a Claude Code Hooks: Complete Guide that covers every hook event, the two return channels, anti-patterns and copy-ready settings.json examples.
notable: Lists the Claude Code Hooks: Complete Guide, featured under 'Start Here' in hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code
